About.title: Three sisters, one voice
About.s1Body: We are Õtekse — a folk-music-inspired ensemble of three sisters from Estonia. We bring together youthful energy, strong musicianship, and a deep connection to traditional culture. Our music is characterised by fresh arrangements of folk songs, where traditional sounds blend with a contemporary approach — which is how we reach audiences of every age.
About.s2Body: Our journey has been marked by several notable achievements. In 2021 we won the Grand Prize at the Mooste Elohelü competition, and in the years that followed we picked up special awards at the same competition. Our arrangement of “Puraviku polka” was performed at the 13th Youth Dance Festival. We have appeared at festivals such as Hiiu Folk, the Viljandi Folk Music Festival, and the international Zemlika Festival. In spring 2026 we had the honour of performing at the Estonian Literary Museum during the Presidential Folk Poetry Awards ceremony. That same year we also took part in the TV show “Laul vs Tants” and were invited onto the “Õhtu” talk show.
About.s3Body: With our distinctive sound and sincere stage presence, we carry Estonian folk music traditions forward while giving them a fresh, contemporary voice.
About.metaDescription: Meet Õtekse, a folk-music-inspired ensemble of three sisters.

Album.title: “RANNA­PIIGAD”
Album.kicker: Õtekse’s first album and EP arrive this autumn.
Album.para1: With our first record we go back to our roots — to where we come from, and to who we are. Our roots reach to Rannametsa in Pärnu County, and that is where the album’s sea themes began.
Album.para2: The three of us, sisters from Rannametsa, are like rannapiigad — shore girls, young women still learning about life, wanting to have fun, to try things, to discover and simply enjoy living. These songs are about all of that.
Album.footnote: Keep an eye out — we will share the details soon.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.metaDescription: How the Õtekse website collects visitor statistics, which cookies it uses, and what your rights are.
Privacy.controllerBody: This website is run by us, Õtekse. For any questions, write to {email}.
Privacy.analyticsBody: We collect visitor statistics with Umami, which we host ourselves on our own server. Umami sets no cookies and does not track you across websites. Your IP address and browser details are processed on the server solely to derive an anonymous daily identifier — they are not retained in a form that identifies you, and are never shared with third parties. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in understanding how the site is used (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)).
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use exactly one cookie — NEXT_LOCALE — which remembers the language you chose. It is strictly necessary for the site to work and so needs no separate consent. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.
Privacy.thirdPartiesBody: This site loads no content from third-party servers: fonts, images and video are served from our own server. Our server reads the Hooandja campaign figures itself; your browser does not contact Hooandja.
Privacy.rightsBody: The statistics we collect are not linked to an identifiable person, so we cannot look up, correct or delete your data — we have no way to identify you from it (GDPR Art. 11). Because we process it on the basis of our legitimate interest, you have the right to object at any time — write to {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (aki.ee).
